subject: [AMBER] WARNING: INCONSISTENCIES EXIST WITHIN INTERNAL POTENTIAL TERMS. THE VALIDITY OF THESE RESULTS ARE HIGHLY QUESTIONABLE

messages.author: 周丽萍
messages.body:
hello,when I use MMGBSA to calculate protein-protein binding energy,the results are so different every time.I am so confused. There is a warning in the output file:INCONSISTENCIES EXIST WITHIN INTERNAL POTENTIAL
TERMS. THE VALIDITY OF THESE RESULTS ARE HIGHLY QUESTIONABLE. The attachment is my output file.Can I ignore this warning?
